page.layout: One page of verse in a single column, with a centred title above it; a catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.

p.i: LASCIVA Musæ cantica virgines Odere, blandas delicias Lyræ Arcent profanæ, non Poetam Pierij patiuntur antri Sacris adesse, & tollere Delphicas Æterna Lauros præmia, si probat Obscœnus incestos amores, Furta docens Veneris nefandæ. Sunt hæc canora murmura tibiæ, Poppæ, Musis dulcia, Numinis Quæ facta supremi recensent, Utque suum moderatur orbem, Seu savientes[?] sacrilega manu Cogat Gigantes regna Proserpinæ Umbrasque pallentes adire, Fulminea metuendus arce: Seu copioso munere largior Fœcundat agros, latáque pascuis Armenta nutrit, pacibúsque Agricolas recreat quietis. Sunt digna Phœbo, sunt Charitum choris Jucunda, vates carmina quæ pius Castúsque Musarum sacerdos Virginibus puerisque cantat:

page.notes: The title line is set in capitals with a second line "Poetam." in small capitals; both are one heading. The verse lines are run together in one paragraph because no stanza breaks are visible. The word after "savientes" is uncertain: the scan shows an ligatured "sa" letter, possibly æ. Initial "L" of LASCIVA is a large letter joined to the word. Pierij's final letter is unclear.
